title: Vibiz (example production profile)
purpose: An example production profile: the VES-1 seed suites for Vibiz's agent (eve/*, gateway/*, mcp-direct/*) over the fictional Lumen Yoga fixtures. Runs through the v1 mock adapter and sim with exact v1 semantics (`ves run --profile vibiz`). The generic packs also apply to Vibiz through catalog.v1.json converted by migrate-v1.ts.
